title: Frontier Town
identity_notes: Syndicated Western legal-adventure series built around Chad Remington and Cherokee O’Bannon in Dos Rios. The 48-object GRH container represents 47 underlying numbered stories plus one exact duplicate archive copy of program #2. Multiple syndication schedules are preserved separately.

eras.label: Later GRH syndication schedule
eras.notes: Later weekly circulation schedule represented by frozen GRH dates; same transcribed stories, not a new production season.

historical_context.title: Frontier law and legal-order storytelling
historical_context.description: The Chad Remington premise places a lawyer and formal legal process inside a Western frontier community.

historical_context.title: Multiple market/distribution chronologies
historical_context.description: The same 47 transcribed stories circulate under an original 1949-50 schedule and the later 1952-53 schedule preserved by GRH.

historical_context.title: Transcription syndication and local commercial insertion
historical_context.description: Frontier Town was produced for syndication; RadioGOLDINdex documents music fill or commercials added locally rather than a single national sponsor.
